banner.name: Nilaya
banner.pitch: A self-hosted life management and logging platform for a family.

hai.statement: Hand-written from 2020 to early 2025. Since then, AI coding tools have helped restore lost work and build new features, and I reviewed, tested and ran every change in production.
hai.note: The full history is in “How AI was (and wasn't) used” below. Provided as is, with no warranty.

lead: Calendar, tasks, habits, contacts, photos, places and notifications for a family, on a server you own, with ideas (and a lot of functionality) borrowed from Google Workspace apps.

banner.name: uwquest
banner.pitch: UWaterloo Quest from your terminal: classes, grades and enrollment. Read-only.

hai.statement: Most of the code was written by AI coding agents. I directed the design, reviewed the changes and tested it on my own account.
hai.note: Unofficial and not affiliated with the University of Waterloo. Provided as is, with no warranty. Read DISCLAIMER.md before use.

fine_print: Use it only on your own account, at a modest request rate, and check UW's acceptable-use policy for automated access. Full terms: [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md)

hai.statement: Written entirely by hand. No AI tools were used at any stage.

hai.note: Deleted messages can't be recovered. Provided as is, with no warranty. Use it at your own risk.

hai.note: Provided as is, with no warranty.

banner.name: Docket
banner.pitch: A school planner I built at 15: one calendar for assignments, class events and school-wide events.

hai.statement: I wrote Docket by hand in 2020–21. In 2026, AI made small fixes so it runs today, removed private data, and wrote this README and the screenshots.
hai.note: Archived for preservation. Provided as is, with no warranty.
